title: Overlapping fish scales with growth rings
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of fish skin: round overlapping scales showing their rear crescents, with growth rings, radial grooves, pigmented edges, a silver colour sheen and koi patches or trout spots. Use for fish, mermaid tails, sea creatures, fantasy armour and aquarium props.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python fish_scales.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: columns
parameters.meaning: Scales across the tile; the row count follows from the exposure.

parameters.name: exposure
parameters.meaning: Row spacing as a share of the scale diameter: how much of each scale shows.

parameters.name: circuli
parameters.meaning: Depth of the growth rings around each scale's centre.

parameters.name: radii
parameters.meaning: Depth of the grooves radiating from the growth centre.

parameters.name: edge_pigment
parameters.meaning: Dark pigment along the free edge of each scale (a net pattern).

parameters.name: iridescence
parameters.meaning: Colour sheen turning across each scale.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.meaning: 0 even colour, 1 large patches of a second colour (koi), 2 dark spots (trout).

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Silver baitfish scales with a blue-green and pink sheen.

presets.name: koi_kohaku
presets.description: White koi scales with large red patches and a faint net.

presets.name: carp_bronze
presets.description: Large bronze carp scales with dark pigmented edges.

presets.name: trout_spotted
presets.description: Small olive trout scales with dark spots and a pink sheen.

limits: Scales are round discs of one size in regular offset rows; the lateral line, fins, the change of scale size along the body and ctenoid spines are out of scope. The head is toward the top of the tile. The sheen is a hue turning across each scale, a stylized stand-in for thin-film reflection that does not change with view angle. Patches and spots are noise fields sampled once per scale. Growth rings fade out where they would be finer than a couple of pixels. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate.
technique_references: Offset-row disc packing with whole counts on the torus
Local overlap order: each row covers the front of the row below
Circuli as cosine rings around an off-centre growth focus
Radial grooves from the angle around the focus
Edge pigment band on the free rim
Hue wheel tint across the scale for iridescence
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
